Koleda is the current head of Belobog Industries, and the biological daughter of the company's founder, Khors.
Her father, Khors, vanished due to a scandal involving embezzlement and fled, which severely shook the company, nearly driving it to the brink of collapse. Once she came of age, Koleda willingly stepped up to untangle the mess, rallying the remaining company workforce and resources to revive the financially and reputationally vulnerable Belobog Heavy Industries.
With the help of new invaluable team members, Belobog eventually managed to regain its prominence in relevant sectors. Though not as resplendent as its prime, Belobog in its current state is still a notable newcomer in the field.
Throughout her journey, Koleda amassed practical life experiences and professional know-how, building a circle of colleagues who back her up like family. Yet, to present herself as a leader, Koleda appears to intentionally adopt a stern tone when communicating with others.
This distinct growth trajectory has also contributed to Koleda's heightened maturity in certain aspects compared to her peers. 
Naturally, she might display a bit of childishness in certain aspects as well.

Hugo calls himself a collector and runs a fairly successful gallery, mingling with the "elite" of New Eridu.
In truth, he's the leader of the phantom thieves syndicate, Mockingbird — and Lycaon's former partner.
Despite his cruel (edgy and dramatic) words, deep down he has his own sense of fairness and justice.

Records suggest that Hugo had a troubled childhood.
As the illegitimate son of the Ravenlocks, a long-established TOPS family, he was rejected by his mother from an early age because of his heterochromatic eyes.
His father bought him back like a cheap commodity, using him to provoke a cutthroat succession battle between his children. In that brutal struggle, the only one kind to Hugo — his sister, Serena — became the first to fall. The ones who orchestrated her death pinned the blame on Hugo, thinking it would destroy him. But to their shock, their father actually praised Hugo's actions, calling them the very traits a worthy heir should possess.
After running away from his family, Hugo met Lycaon and Jack and learned to be a phantom thief. After Jack passed away, Hugo and Lycaon formed Mockingbird together.

Later, during one of Mockingbird's missions, Hugo came face-to-face with his father. In a brief moment of hesitation, he chose not to take his revenge and kill him — an act of mercy that ended up costing the lives of many innocent people. His close friend Lycaon, due to a misunderstanding born from those circumstances, broke ties with him and ultimately left Mockingbird.
After drifting on his own for a while, Hugo met Vivian, a girl who reminded him of his sister Serena. He took her under his wing and reformed the Mockingbird syndicate.
profile.profile_02:
Back during his time with the Ravenlock family, Hugo once ate a piece of cake that his older brother liked. In retaliation, the other children forced him to eat an entire table's worth of desserts.
Ever since, the taste of anything sweet makes him want to throw up — likely due to PTSD.
But due to his hypoglycemia, he needs sugar to keep his body functioning properly. Hugo forces himself to eat sweets over and over, pushing through the nausea to overcome the pain.
Note: Neither Lycaon nor Vivian knows about this, and Hugo once asked you to keep it a secret from them.

Lucia grew up surrounded by her kin, and even after arriving in New Eridu, she has kept to the Nightwatcher tradition of staying awake through the night and watching over her cherished friends, shielding them from the Night Horror's reach.
Master, if you hear a knock at your window late at night, don't be alarmed. It may just be a sleepless night guardian stopping by to say hello.

Additional note: Lucia's pet is "Chestnut," a small, friendly Hati. It once lived in the Hollow's outskirts, but has since moved deeper inside. Even I can no longer detect its exact whereabouts.
profile.profile_02:
Lucia's father worked with the Defense Force's special forces, and because of his demanding duties, he could only return home once a year. For young Lucia, that time with him felt like a reward in itself.
While on leave one time, Lucia's father received an emergency order and had to depart at once. To calm his crying daughter before leaving, he coaxed her into covering her eyes for a game of hide-and-seek. By the time she finished counting and opened them, he was already gone, never to return again.
Years later, during an operation in the Town, Lucia came face-to-face with her father, now corrupted into the Wandering Hunter. To the soft tune of a nursery rhyme, she at last brought their unfinished hide-and-seek to an end. The Wandering Hunter laid down his obsession, tainted by miasma, and slowly faded away. Their reunion took place here — as did their farewell.

sender_note.sender_note1:
Impressions of Lucia:
 · She arrives under cover of night, like a mystery beneath the starry sky.
sender_note.sender_note2: · Passing through countless tales, walking within boundless dreams.
sender_note.sender_note3: · May your travels never end.

impression.sister:
Lucia enjoys traveling the Hollows alone and tracking down Ethereals. She also often shows up with snacks, tapping on the window before slipping into the video store to watch a movie...
She's always popping up in different places with a bright smile — just like a little sprite flitting through the night!
impression.brother:
Ever since getting hooked on Lucia's Bangboo ghost stories, Eous has stopped going to bed on time...
Now it just camps out at the front desk, ears pricked for the sound of tapping on the window... What a headache.

profile.profile_01:
Zhao, a Krampus Compliance Authority Judge, was one of the elite members who joined in the early days.

Though she looks innocent and cute on the outside, she's actually sharp-minded, meticulous, and principled. She puts great importance on "value" and "equivalent exchange" — not in the sense of pricing things with money, but in analyzing someone's ability and potential, giving an objective and long-term assessment of the impact they can make.

It's said this mindset didn't come from Zhao's work at Krampus, but had already taken root during her childhood. She evaluates not only others, but herself as well. "Only those with value deserve to be seen."

Though she rarely shows it openly, Zhao remains cautious toward kindness that comes without reason. It conflicts with her belief in "equivalent exchange," and she tends to assume the other person must have a deeper motive for offering help.
As such, when dealing with Zhao, it's best to focus on mutual benefit first. If you want to break through her defenses with sheer sincerity and goodwill, you'll be fighting an uphill battle.

There's also one piece of intel that can't be fully confirmed: Zhao loves vegetables and dislikes meat, but she seems to be pretending she enjoys meat as well.
profile.profile_02:
Zhao grew up in a large family that was both poor and struggling, where affection and trust never outweighed the rule of survival: "Whoever can bring the most benefit gets more to eat."

She looked sweet and likeable, but that only made others think she was easy prey. In that harsh, predatory environment, people quickly labeled her as "low value." So her elders wrote her off as someone who'd never amount to anything, leaving her to a fate of being dismissed and abandoned. Everything changed when she met a Krampus official who saw her hidden potential instantly. From that moment on, she sealed away her past with her family, joined Krampus, and vowed to prove her true worth.
"Once you have value, you'll be seen even if you're crawling in the mud."

sender_note.sender_note1:
Impressions of Zhao:
 · To someone like Xiao'Zhao, who cares deeply about value, a trading partner is a very dependable connection.
sender_note.sender_note2: · But when a partner offers help without asking for anything in return, Xiao'Zhao gets a bit uncomfortable. It's not that she dislikes them — she just can't figure out what she's supposed to offer back to complete the "transaction."
sender_note.sender_note3: · As more partners like that appeared in her life, Xiao'Zhao eventually realized that being liked isn't a bad thing at all, and it has nothing to do with how much value she holds.

impression.sister: I feel especially safe when I'm out investigating with Xiao'Zhao. Like... she's the kind of person who never loses out when dealing with others.
impression.brother: Whenever the group decides on something and Xiao'Zhao raises no objections, you can bet she's judged the pros and cons and found it worth attempting.

profile.profile_01:
Banyue is an Intelligent Construct who runs a martial arts school in Waifei, known to many as "Banyue Shifu." He has lived for a long time, his stone-lion-like presence commanding respect. A martial arts expert of great skill, he shares a long-standing friendship with Yunkui Summit's current High Preceptor, Yixuan.

As a martial master, Banyue is quiet but dependable. His methods and beliefs are rooted in tradition, and he disciplines his students with strict yet thoughtful guidance, teaching them not just how to fight, but how to learn. Known as a true master of the martial arts, in battle, he can assume a special form known as the Visage of Wrath to vanquish all evil.

A long inhabitant of Waifei, Banyue is quiet and even-tempered. He doesn't express emotions easily and has the manner of someone from another era. Knowing he's out of touch with modern trends, he's been secretly trying to learn the latest internet slang... yet his half-baked grasp of it tends to end in funny little misunderstandings.

Banyue also appears to have a strange liking for round things — stone balls, spherical bollards, and the like. If the conversation ever goes silent while you're alone with him, bringing up something spherical usually does the trick.
profile.profile_02:
Banyue's true identity is that of a killing machine secretly developed years ago by TOPS, specifically designed to suppress Miasma and codenamed "Purge Unit - Type Zero." The algorithm implanted within him drives him to act according to the most logical solution for eliminating Miasma, which often results in indiscriminate annihilation of all moving targets within sight, including both the Miasma and affected civilians.

After a failed operation, Banyue, then still a mere machine, was abandoned by TOPS, but was then discovered by a sage visiting the Lemnian Hollow, who rewrote his Core and constructed new intelligent logic for him, allowing Banyue to gradually develop self-awareness. Later, Banyue was accepted by the residents of the old mining site in Waifei Peninsula, where he integrated into "human" life.

During the catastrophic Miasma outbreak at the old mining site ten years ago, Banyue rushed to rescue the civilians, yet under the influence of his perfectly rational algorithms, he abandoned those he deemed beyond saving. Though he saved the young Ye Shunguang and Ye Shiyuan, this planted a deep-seated guilt within him for "abandoning those in need." As a result, Banyue never took the Forbidden Fruit test, and despite meeting the criteria of an Intelligent Construct, he remains officially unrecognized as one.

After receiving judgment from Dialyn, a Judge of the Krampus Compliance Authority, Banyue resolved to atone for his past regrets by protecting the future. Through Dialyn's recommendation, he has now become a Judge of the Krampus Compliance Authority, embarking on a completely new journey.

sender_note.sender_note1:
Impressions of Banyue:
 · Intelligent Construct problem #1: the metal detector always goes off.
sender_note.sender_note2: · Intelligent Construct problem #2: maintaining antique parts.
sender_note.sender_note3: · Intelligent Construct problem #3: how do you measure the weight of a heart?

impression.sister: Banyue Shifu may look calm and composed, but he's actually got a timid side! Last time he visited Suibian Temple, a mouse happened to scurry in, and though he did his best to hide it, it was clear he was unsettled...
impression.brother: Come to think of it, one time, a kid dropped a marble, and he kept looking at it... I guess Banyue Shifu isn't always the composed martial arts master he seems to be.

profile.profile_01:
Dialyn works as a customer service representative for TOPS' Cross-Department Customer Service Center, though few know her other identity — a Krampus Compliance Authority Judge.

She calls herself TOPS' top-rated representative, yet she also tops the list for the most complaints in the department. Despite never flaunting her authority as a Judge, she always delivers verdicts that cut closest to the truth.

Dialyn was born with the ability to hear the voices of those on the brink of death within the Hollows — a talent that's unmatched. Yet to a young Dialyn, it was a tormenting curse.

Be it gift or curse, she has long turned it into a blade for discerning the truth. Despite the trials and tribulations she's borne, she's come far.
profile.profile_02:
"Curse" — not just a word for the torment of those endless voices of the dead echoing through the Hollows, but also for the ill fate brought by such a sinister gift.

Before a secondary Hollow outbreak, Dialyn's neighbors, misled by a construction company, turned on her, sending the "ill-omened" child into a Hollow as a sacrifice for their own safety.

Naive to humanity's cruelty but kind at heart, the young Dialyn willingly offered her life to save everyone, but upon stepping into the Hollow, her accursed gift revealed the cruel truth: it had all been a scheme by the construction company. The residents — whose lives had been covered by massive insurance policies — were doomed to die within the Hollow, and Dialyn was simply the bait to keep them from fleeing.

She heard her secret curse betrayed, the hatred the dead had towards her, the voices of all who perished, and the lies of those who lived. She can no longer recall how she made it through that barren wasteland. But ever since Krampus took her in, she's been ready: Amid the unending struggle between lies and truth, she would learn to pass her own judgment on good and evil.

sender_note.sender_note1:
Impressions of Dialyn:
 · Hi there! This is your one and only top-rated customer service rep~
sender_note.sender_note2: · Every remarkable person ends up getting countless complaints.
sender_note.sender_note3: · Calls and regrets from the past — I'll answer them in yesterday's place.

impression.sister: She might seem to switch back and forth between jokes and sarcasm, but if you have the patience to listen closely, you'll find that deep down, Dialyn is someone with strong principles and real courage!
impression.brother: Dialyn may come across as a little harsh sometimes, but she's the type to always speak up against injustice and be honest with her friends. She's even the one who told me about Belle sneaking out to hang out with our Agents without me.

profile.profile_01:
Sunna is a member of the Angels of Delusion idol group and the composer behind all of the group's music. Maintaining top-tier songwriting while keeping pace with rehearsals and stage performances is anything but easy for her. When the pressure piles up, she occasionally employs the tactic of "retreat is the best option" to dodge Captain Nangong Yu's brutal scheduling.
Note: Reliable intelligence suggests that this tactic works largely because Nangong Yu intentionally lets it slide.

Sunna and Nangong Yu, another member of the Angels of Delusion, have known each other since they were young and grew up together. While they appear to always squabble, the two are in fact deeply dependent on one another. When it comes to music, Sunna shares a strong connection with their final member, Aria. As Aria puts it, the two frequently spend whole days in the studio discussing melodies for new songs, only to drift off to sleep without even realizing it, heads resting against each other.

Sunna is fairly introverted and prefers spending time alone over group activities. That said, her two teammates know her weaknesses all too well — she finds it hard to say no and can't handle praise — and are helping her gradually overcome her social anxiety through desensitization training (progress: about 25%).

While most fans see Sunna's "hopeless" side as endearing, she herself seems eager to tear off that label and become a confident, "proper idol." As the creative force behind the music, she often wants to flee the stage — yet in truth, she's not as indifferent to performing as she claims to be.
Evidence: A sticky note by Sunna's bedside that reads "I can't disappoint the fans. I need to give them my very best on stage!"
profile.profile_02:
Sunna has a weakness for sweets that look cute, which often leads her to buy treats that are all looks and far too sugary — something Nangong never misses a chance to tease her about. Even so, when Nangong and Aria pick out gifts for Sunna, they always settle on cupcakes with colorful, eye-catching designs.
Sunna also loves things with gentle, fragrant scents and often makes scented candles herself, as they help her focus her thoughts and spark inspiration. Once she enters her own "musical kingdom," she becomes so absorbed that she can barely hear anything from the outside world.
Note: According to Aria, Sunna once burned Nangong's limited-edition teapot dry while writing a song. To make it up to her, Sunna spent more than two weeks serving tea and running errands for Nangong as an apology.

sender_note.sender_note1:
Impressions of Sunna:
 · She moves like a little deer in the mountains, lightly leaping over every hardship, with musical notes rising from where she steps.
sender_note.sender_note2: · Delusions stretch out long, slender branches, quietly binding one person's daydream into a grand story shared by three.
sender_note.sender_note3: · Lets keep humming along and walk forward into this pink-tinted summer.

impression.sister:
Sometimes Sunna reminds me of some kind of rare creature in a game — she only spawns under very specific conditions!
Last time, I had to bug her for a whole week just to get her to go clothes shopping with me!
impression.brother: Yeah, I've had my fair share of Belle's nonstop badgering... I bet Sunna couldn't handle it either.

profile.profile_01:
Aria is the lead vocalist and center of the Angels of Delusion. Bright and full of energy, she always shines on stage, bringing warmth and strength to all Delulus.
She has a near-perfect voice, even though she was never professionally trained. At first, Aria only sang because she loved her idol, the retired songstress Cersea, copying her performances and singing along, until she realized she had a gift for song of her own.
Though Aria's vocal skills are undeniably professional, she lacks a solid foundation in dance. Even with dedicated practice, she can still get flustered when faced with more complex moves. Still, fans deeply appreciate her attitude of "even if I can't dance well, I'll still give it everything I've got."
"Pushing herself to the limit, wrestling with her own limbs to try and keep up with the rhythm... that's our Angels of Delusion lead vocalist!" —One Delulu sobbing after a show.
profile.profile_02:
Unlike her bright, glamorous stage persona, Aria's true form is an A-H0L0 Type Intelligent Tactical Construct, built for combat. However, as she took part in more combat operations, she slowly grew to hate the feeling of "bringing pain to others."
After being abandoned in a Hollow alongside others of the same model, she was awakened once more by Cersea's singing. In Eridu, she saw how such a voice could spark hope in people and draw them into "delusions," and it was then that the desire to sing began to take root within her. By chance, she once served as Cersea's "voice double," but after Cersea retired, she returned to normal life. It was only after being invited by Nangong and Sunna to join the Angels of Delusion that Aria truly stepped onto the stage, meeting the Delulus who loved her voice face-to-face.
Perhaps shaped by her past experiences, Aria feels deeply insecure about her identity as a construct. When she switches to her construct form, she becomes shy and timid, speaking slowly and hesitantly. But the moment she activates her energetic idol projection, she instantly returns to her bright, outgoing, high-energy self, shining like a little sun on her teammates and the Delulus in the audience.

sender_note.sender_note1:
Impressions of Aria:
 · The Three Principles of Idol Constructs, One: No matter when, always stay full of energy!
sender_note.sender_note2: · The Three Principles of Idol Constructs, Two: No matter where, always keep your image up!
sender_note.sender_note3: · The Three Principles of Idol Constructs, Three: No matter what, always remember to charge up in advance!

impression.sister: An idol performing on stage with a virtual avatar... Does that count as being a virtual idol?
impression.brother: Uh... That doesn't feel quite right, Belle... but I honestly don't know how to refute it...
